### Summary

Coverage is a relation between a configuration and a test assertion, not a probability or an accuracy
estimate. A row is supported only when both the registration and the test's actual arm agree; a guard
assertion supports setup behaviour, not an error norm. Check line `[C11]` states the relation as a table:
support is the conjunction of registration and arm over its four combinations, and of the four (assertion
kind, claim kind) pairs exactly one is unsupported, a guard assertion offered for an error norm
[check `src/snapy_report/ch12/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/configuration_check.out`].

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** N/A: the matrix relates a switch combination to the registered test that exercises it, so a
reader can tell a constrained combination from one with no evidence.

**Data.** In: the registrations of `tests/CMakeLists.txt` and the arms each test script creates. Out: one row
per registered combination; the table lists selected evidence, not every test of the project.

**Placement.** Reading time; a row is supported only when the registration and the test's actual arm agree.

**Activation.** The abbreviations: WB = `SNAP_WB_REF4`, XC = `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, FC =
`SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE`, MC = `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE`, RE = `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`. Defaults: WB,
XC and MC off; FC and RE on; XC implies WB. `<b>` is the build suffix. "child" means the script creates one
fresh process per arm; "CTest" means the registration sets the variable.

**Guarantee / limits.** A guard assertion supports setup behaviour, not an error norm; a registered CUDA or
two-rank entry is evidence of registration only. Unspecified flags must be sanitized when a row is reproduced.

**Evidence.** The rows below name their tests; the chapter's check `[C11]` states the support relation; none of
the ctests was run at the pin.
:::

|---|---|---|---|

### Derivation

### Numerical method

First select a build that contains the required entries, then establish the import provenance, sanitize the
numerics switches, and launch the named arm. Compare the invariant that the gravity-work mode selects: energy
plus corrected potential energy for `face` with RE on, energy plus plain potential energy otherwise. Record
CPU or CUDA and the rank count with every measured result. The dependency figure shows the logical constraints
of the switches, not measured performance.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-matrix-flow
#| fig-cap: "Logical dependencies: labelled arrows mean implies, requires, or acts only with. The diagram is not a sequence of numerical operations."
#| fig-alt: "XC implies WB; WB + gravity: 3 ghosts; MC + gravity: 3 owned cells; RE + face + supported grid; FC: per-direction source."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch12.fig_matrix_flow import make_fig
make_fig()
```

1. Read the CTest registrations and their environments. The anchor `seam_arm` is in
   {{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}}.
2. Read the arms each script creates in its own child processes. The anchor `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` of the
   combined oracle is set in {{< code tests/test_wb_ref4_order.py main >}}.
3. Enter a row only where the registration and the arm agree.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| all entries in the matrix | registered assertions only | see the individual scheme tables | no runtime results in this chapter |

: Source assertions, not new solver measurements. {#tbl-ch12-matrix-tests}

No snapy runtime test is executed for this chapter. CUDA and multi-rank entries describe registration only.
The independent checks and their outputs are catalogued in @sec-ch15-ch12-tests.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Numerical MC behaviour, XC with face work or RE, XC together with FC, WB or XC on gnomonic grids, WB with RE off
under face work, FC across MPI ranks, and the wider simultaneous combinations have no registered evidence.
WB together with FC and RE has a registered order oracle; an all-flags combination is not thereby covered.

The complete switch inventory is this section.
:::
